title: The waiter guard allows one bounded background wait for a clock time, and its remedy names only allowed forms
why: Owner ask ask-mw74y9cw3z, 19:10 CST Nov 7, from a Degen lane on 2026-11-06 16:40-16:44 CST: a wait of about 8 min for a known clock time was refused three times. Read on main: waiter_verdict (hooks/guard_stream.py:210) refuses a sleep of 25 s or more and any sleep loop even under run_in_background, yet WAITER_REASON (line 248) offers 'run the long command in the background'. A remedy the guard refuses is a false alarm (rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent). No allowed form waits for a clock time; only wait-pid exists.
note: Fix: add a `wait-until <ISO time> [--timeout S]` helper beside bin/wait-pid and name it in the remedy; allow a backgrounded single bounded wait; a foreground poll loop still refuses. Unverified: (b) the owner's `override` did not lift the refusal (no guard.log here; override.py names no waiter exclusion); and whether the guard sees the Monitor tool today (no Monitor matcher found in hooks/guard.py or settings.json). Done check: red first on main: forms 1 and 2 (backgrounded, single run, deadline-bounded) pass, a foreground poll loop refuses, one owner override lifts one waiter refusal, and the remedy names only allowed forms. Lane started 19:11 CST (coordinator); the override reproduction and the Monitor reach are in its brief. Built as #1797; with runner 8 (coordinator, 23:52 CST Nov 7). The unknown part (b) moves to step waiter-override-log-read.
